source.name: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), county level, full monthly history
source.metric: Smoothed asking rent, all home types, monthly
source.caveat: ZORI is a smoothed index, and smoothing damps exactly the within-year movement measured here. These amplitudes are therefore conservative.

method: Classical multiplicative decomposition: value divided by a 12-month centred moving average, averaged by calendar month, normalised to mean 1.0.
